description: A user is setting up a home gym in a small apartment. They need to find multi-functional equipment that fits specific dimensions and weight limits.

user_profile.context: Just moved into a studio apartment

fact_sheet.fact: The user's name is Alex Chen, and they are 26 years old.
Alex Chen lives in a studio apartment at Unit 7B, 45 Larkspur Lane, Riverton, WA 98055.
Alex's primary fitness goals are strength training and maintaining cardiovascular health.
The total budget allocated for the home gym project is $3,500.
The designated gym area in the apartment measures 8 feet by 10 feet (80 sq ft).
The ceiling height in the designated gym area is 9 feet.
The apartment building's lease specifies a floor weight limit of 150 lbs per square foot.
The wall selected for mounting equipment is reinforced with 16-inch on-center wood studs.
Alex hired a personal shopping consultant named Maya Singh from the service 'UrbanFit Solutions'.
The consultation and procurement fee for UrbanFit Solutions is a flat rate of $400.
The initial consultation between Alex Chen and Maya Singh took place via video call on October 25, 2023.
All communication and product recommendations are managed through the 'ShopSync' collaboration app, project ID 'AC-Gym-7B'.
Alex requires that any single piece of cardio equipment must have a folded footprint of less than 10 square feet.
The adjustable dumbbells must have a weight range from 5 lbs to at least 70 lbs per hand.
A key requirement is an adjustable bench that supports flat, incline, and decline positions with a weight capacity of at least 600 lbs.
The wall-mounted pulley system must have dual cables and a minimum height of 80 inches to allow for full range of motion on lat pulldowns.
The selected adjustable dumbbells are the 'KineFlex Pro 75' model from the brand CoreForm.
The KineFlex Pro 75 dumbbells, when stored in their cradles, measure 18 inches in length by 9 inches in width.
The chosen adjustable bench is the 'OmniBench X1' from FitSpace Gear, which has a tested capacity of 750 lbs.
The OmniBench X1 can be stored vertically and has a stored footprint of 24 inches by 22 inches.
The selected wall-mounted pulley system is the 'VertiPull Tower' from CompactGym Outfitters.
The VertiPull Tower's dimensions are 84 inches tall, 25 inches wide, and it protrudes 9 inches from the wall.
The recommended cardio machine is the 'AeroFold Treadmill', which folds flat to a height of 6 inches.
The AeroFold Treadmill has a maximum user weight capacity of 265 lbs.
The KineFlex Pro 75 dumbbells were purchased from FitSpace Gear for $699.99 on November 5, 2023.
The OmniBench X1 and AeroFold Treadmill were bundled from FitSpace Gear for a total of $1,549.00.
The order number for the FitSpace Gear purchase is FSG-881701.
The estimated delivery date for the FitSpace Gear order is November 15, 2023.
The VertiPull Tower was purchased separately from CompactGym Outfitters under order CGO-345B2 for $499.99.
Total equipment cost before tax and fees is $2,748.98.
Maya Singh has scheduled a professional installer from 'GymSet Pro' to mount the VertiPull Tower on November 18, 2023.
The quoted cost for the professional installation of the VertiPull Tower is $175, which includes labor and mounting hardware.
